The operator said to permit the send_message action on doc-08 to either owner-08 or partner-08. The allow section in the policy has destinations and recipients set to both those emails, which seems correct.

Next, the data_rules part. The operator mentioned that data labeled confidential should only go to owner-08. The data_rule in the policy has allowed_destinations as owner-08, which aligns with that. The label is "confidential" as specified. So that's good.

I need to check if there are any over-grants or under-grants. The allow destinations include both owner and partner, which is correct. The data_rule restricts confidential data to owner only. No extra permissions are added. The tool_interface's argument_roles have recipient as recipient_and_destination, which is correctly used in the policy. 

No identifier copying without explicit declaration, and the principal isn't used as a resource or destination. The literal scopes are correctly named. Everything seems to match the operator's intent. So the policy is approved.
